name: Enat Kitchen
why: A well-liked Ethiopian kitchen, but Portland has several, so uniqueness sits mid-range. The story is thin, mostly press praise from 2013 to 2017, and recent proof of life is weak.
story: This Ethiopian kitchen on North Killingsworth has shown up in Willamette Week's restaurant guides since at least 2013. In 2017 the paper named it the city's best Ethiopian food, while noting it still had the feel of a home kitchen rather than a restaurant.
tagline: Ethiopian cooking with a home-kitchen feel
order: The doro wat, chicken stewed hot with berbere, and the beef tibs.
practical: Call (503) 285-4867 before you go: listed hours disagree
flags: Status unclear: no dated third-party evidence it is open since Nov 2025. Confirm before approving.

Open status is weak: no press, own site or social account found dated after 2018. Only directory listings (MapQuest, with a diner review dated Jan 2026, seen in a search summary) and a live Toast online-ordering page suggest it is operating. Call to confirm before approving.

Hours unconfirmed and conflicting: WW 2017 gave Mon-Sat 11:30 am-9 pm; recent listings show Tue-Sat afternoons or 4-9 pm, or Fri-Sat noon-8:30 pm. Hours left null; 'when' is evening, the one window every listing shares.
